topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Well now, ain't that a turn up for the books! I just got this package, wrapped all tidy and proper, and looking as if it held the very stars inside. But here’s the queer part—it’s not meant for me, turns out! It’s for the old Pollard fellow who used to live in my cottage. I reckon he must have moved on, the cheeky old rogue, without so much as a by-your-leave. Now, I’m thinking of what to do with it. Maybe I’ll take it to the village square and see if someone knows where he's skulked off to. It’s got his name on it, after all, and it wouldn’t be right to just leave it aside. But what a fine surprise this morning has been, discovering a mystery right on my own doorstep!
